content.text: If you're a digital creator from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or other regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-minimum-viable-stack|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms are restricted or unavailable, you're likely facing the daunting task of setting up a digital store without sacrificing your creative freedom or losing your customer base. In this step-by-step guide, we'll walk through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-5|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]]-pages-free-step-step-8|deploying]] a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, using a sovereign commerce infrastructure that's designed to work when platforms fail. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can have a fully operational online store up and running in as little as 4-6 hours or 48 hours, respectively, without relying on Stripe or any other restricted payment processor.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Unlike traditional digital store setups that rely on Stripe, PayPal, or other centralized payment processors, this sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to give you full ownership and control over your digital store. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, you can create a seamless and secure payment and delivery pipeline that's not beholden to any single platform or payment processor. This means that even if Stripe or other platforms restrict or shut down your access, your digital store will continue to function smoothly, without any interruptions or losses.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to meet a few prerequisites. First, you'll need to have a GitHub or Cloudflare account, as well as a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You'll also need to have a NOWPayments account, which will serve as your payment processor. For the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll need to have a Cloudflare account and a basic understanding of Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. Once you've met these prerequisites, you can begin setting up your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The first step in setting up your digital store on Cloudflare Pages is to configure your payment processor. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and others. To set up your payment pipeline, you'll need to create a new NOWPayments account, configure your payment settings, and integrate your payment gateway with your Cloudflare Pages site. You'll also need to set up your delivery pipeline, using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your digital products to your customers. This will ensure that your customers receive their downloads securely and reliably, without any delays or issues.
Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages is a secure and reliable way to sell your digital products, without sacrificing your creative freedom or losing your customer base.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your digital store. To do this, you'll need to update your Cloudflare Pages site to reflect your new payment settings and delivery pipeline. You'll also need to test your site to ensure that everything is working smoothly, from payment processing to file delivery. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), you can have a fully operational online store up and running in as little as 4-6 hours, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can have you up and running in just 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, you can focus on scaling your business. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll have access to advanced features like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, which will enable you to handle large volumes of traffic and transactions. You'll also have access to 30-day support, ensuring that you can get help whenever you need it. By scaling your business effectively, you can take your digital store to the next level and achieve your full potential.

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'Can I really deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or other restricted payment processors?' The answer is yes. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can have a fully operational online store up and running in as little as 4-6 hours or 48 hours, respectively, without sacrificing your creative freedom or losing your customer base. This sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to give you full ownership and control over your digital store, ensuring that your business remains secure and reliable, even in the face of platform failures or restrictions.
With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can have a fully operational online store up and running in just 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.

If you're looking for more information on deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you may also want to check out our Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and can have you up and running in just 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. To learn more, please visit our Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these concrete steps: Create a new GitHub or Cloudflare account and basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings. Integrate your payment gateway with your Cloudflare Pages site. Set up your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Update your Cloudflare Pages site to reflect your new payment settings and delivery pipeline. Test your site to ensure that everything is working smoothly. Deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to get started.

Yes, you can host your digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Simply create a new GitHub or Cloudflare account, set up your site, and configure your payment processor.
